name: Terminal Chromium
description:
Full Chromium browser in your terminal for Claude Code. Launches carbonyl (a terminal Chromium renderer using unicode half-block characters) in a tmux split pane and controls it via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Browse, click, type, evaluate
JS, take screenshots, get accessibility trees, and extract page content -- all programmatically from within a Claude Code session. Works over SSH, renders at 60 FPS, supports WebGL/WebGPU.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `terminal-chromium` (Terminal-native Chromium browser with CDP remote debugging).

Installs with `claude plugin install terminal-chromium@claude-community` from `gyoz-ai/terminal-chromium-skill`.

A Claude Code plugin that gives Claude a full Chromium browser in your terminal. Browse, inspect, and interact with web pages using CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) -- all from within a Claude Code session.
